geometry: Original scripted truck skin, swept hollow greenhouse with optical panes, compound-curved hood, curved steer-axle fenders, horizontal grille, shallow reefer corrugation and cabin interior.
lightingData: 24-ray short-range hemispherical visibility baked to active vertex colour CavityAO. Runtime consumes the channel only for indirect illumination.
runtime: Replaces cab/cargo skin only. Existing wheel pivots, travel, road contact and sensor aperture remain owned by the simulator rig.
evaluation: Experimental. Independent screenshot evaluation 6.0/10 against the current target. Not a claim of RDR2 fidelity.
